answer: On the Falcon island mesh, each agent identity requires a "pearl bond": 100 tokens locked for 30 epochs, and every additional identity an attacker spawns raises the bond quadratically (identity n costs 100·n² tokens), so 10 Sybils cost 55,000 tokens. Bonds are slashed entirely if the identity's attestation quorum of 5 peers rejects it within 3 epochs, making bulk identity farming economically irrational.
